note: Original 1965 description of a new species, covering both the alate and the soldier, with comparisons and the type locality.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Both the alate and the soldier are close to C. bengalensis, from which they differ in the broader pronotum of the alate and, in the soldier, in the frontal protuberance lacking a median notch and the pronotum being slightly rectangular rather than nearly circular. Both castes of C. cynocephalus and C. perforans are smaller; the soldier of C. dudleyi is larger; in the alate of C. sumatrensis the middle of the anterior pronotal margin is notched, and in its soldier the frontal protuberance is deeply concave; in the alate of C. domesticus the compound eyes are smaller, and in its soldier the antennal base bears only one tubercle. In the key the alate of the present species has a compound eye long diameter of 0.27—0.30 mm, and the soldier has two tubercles at the antennal base.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head reddish brown; anteclypeus pale yellow; labrum pale yellow-brown; mandibles yellow-brown with reddish brown teeth; antennae yellow-brown; pronotum slightly darker than the head, with a T-shaped mark; wings pale smoky brown. Head sparsely hairy; the anterolateral margins, the sides and the disc of the pronotum with scattered short and long setae. Head semicircular behind the compound eyes; the median arm of the Y-shaped suture distinct, the rest indistinct. Compound eyes moderately protruding, shaped as in Fig. 8; ocelli small, oval, almost touching the compound eyes. Anteclypeus trapezoidal. Labrum broad, dome-shaped, the sides converging posteriorly. In the left mandible the posterior cutting edge of marginal tooth 1 is distinctly shorter than the anterior cutting edge of marginal tooth 2; in the right mandible the posterior cutting edge of marginal tooth 2 is longer than the molar plate. Antennae 14—15-segmented; in the 14-segmented condition segment 2 as long as segment 3, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 2. Pronotum slightly wider than the head, its length more than half its width; anterior margin shallowly concave; sides weakly convex; middle of the posterior margin depressed; anterolateral corners broadly rounded.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Posterior part of the head reddish brown, deepening anteriorly, the frontal region almost black; labrum yellow; pronotum pale yellow-brown with dark patches on the disc; legs pale; abdominal tergites pale brown. Head sparsely hairy, with a few short setae at the anterolateral corners; anterior margin of the pronotum with short setae, the disc with scattered long setae. Head strongly prognathous, short and thick, its length about equal to its width; Y-shaped suture present but indistinct; frontal protuberance prominent and concave, without a median notch; frontal face almost vertical, not inclined outward; antennal base with one flap-like projection above and one below. Compound eyes whitish, oval, 0.10 mm long and 0.03 mm wide. Mandibles short, distinctly swollen at the base, the teeth reduced. Labrum short, the apex broadly rounded. Antennae short, 11-segmented; the basal 3 segments more strongly sclerotized, segment 2 almost as long as segment 3, segment 4 the shortest. Pronotum as wide as the head, its length slightly more than half its width; anterior margin broadly V-shaped with fine serrations; anterolateral lobes notched; sides moderately protruding, depressed behind the anterolateral corners; posterior margin almost straight.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm). Alates, 2 individuals (morphotype and paramorphotype): head length to the tip of the labrum 1.19, 1.26; head length to the base of the mandibles 0.96, 0.98; head width 0.93, 0.96; compound eye long diameter 0.27, 0.30; compound eye short diameter 0.21, 0.23; distance from the lower edge of the compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.18, 0.19; ocellus length 0.09, 0.10; ocellus width 0.08, 0.08; pronotal length 0.57, 0.61; pronotal width 1.02, 1.02. Soldier holotype: head length to the base of the mandibles 1.30; head width 1.26; left mandible length 0.64; pronotal length 0.68; pronotal width 1.26. Type locality Klang Dong, Thailand; 2 alates, 1 soldier and nymphs, collected 1962-03-22 inside the trunk of Ficus.
